folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B211, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full relationship-prerequisites audit was reviewed beyond its completion note. Its source inspection corrected nine of fifteen composite Have cells, including one citation-only correction; this does not mean nine missing mechanics. Existing moods, tastes, negative regard, direct memories, party contest and heir recognition qualified the initial absence claims. These are findings at that audit’s source input, not a new current-code census (AD32/AD36).

Retain the practical reader contract: actor-to-target regard is not target-to-actor willingness, memory direction is not automatically visible to its subject, and private regard is distinct from audience reputation, rank/title and ownership. Existing chronicles and simulation axes differ in bounds and meanings; a mandatory store merge is unnecessary for a direction label or selected offer. Names matching does not establish actor identity. One effect family’s same-cause receipt may collapse two deltas, while direct writers need their own settlement identity. Genuine later shared work can use a fresh occurrence without making retries new events.

Recent-memory trimming must not erase a durable fact that a current offer, commitment or recognition reader requires; replay receipts and durable facts have different retention needs. Counts such as 32 memories or 64 owners are historical validation bounds, not friend limits or measured performance budgets. Sparse edges/scheduling are proposals until a selected workload is measured. Annual authored-news reveal is not autonomous social simulation. Paid escrow packing is distinct from general closed-browser social progression. Reliable supported idle work can deepen a relationship under its world/person mechanism; no blanket passive-trust ban or daily click cap follows from the palette (AD22/AD52).

N1–N5 and Q1–Q4 are historical proposals, not requirements for a new audit approval or universal family/offline implementation. Apply current desktop targets and AD42 to any selected UI proof. Only the owner tail was inspected for this fold; B211 does not claim a full read of this extended palette or new runtime verification.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B211, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full report, ten prepared route prompts, P11–P13 and all eighteen preservation rows were read. Preserve three different residues: a missing recorded corpus, available but unread consumer bodies, and a decoded representation whose native/VM semantics remain unresolved. Recovered locators, file copies and token counts do not close those different questions. Heaven’s Vault control indexes are lookup identity rather than resolved dialogue reachability; Idleon’s normalized wiki data is separate from the official client and server settlement; N64 reconstruction does not establish MM3D; URR 0.10.4d listings do not establish 0.11 behavior. An exported method census is not the selected predicate → action → spend/mutation → later consequence chain (AD32/AD36).

The report already records newer Vagrus, Path, Immortality Idle, Groundhog Life and community-prestige follow-ups qualifying earlier gaps. Its eighteen preservation folders and file/byte totals are historical delivery evidence, not present availability, full-reading percentages or permission to expose private prose. Missing roots do not prove no archive exists elsewhere. Live-lane exclusions and optional REA observations belong to their date. Use the current tool registry before a newly selected restoration; no new acquisition, decompilation, install or runtime execution follows from these old prompts. B211 read the report, not its private corpora or linked JSON validation.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B211, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full census, lane snapshot, executable/app tables, queue proposal and Oct19 update were reviewed. Keep the denominators separate: report directories, game-focused dossiers, aggregate routes, adoption entries, individual game rows and installed manifests count different things. None establishes purchase entitlement, complete source reading or shipped YAIR behavior. Oct19’s different local manifest census supersedes that aspect of the Oct14 observation without erasing the older snapshot. “In flight” included waiting dispatches, not proof of a running process. The queue patch was only prepared/dry-run checked here; this report does not establish its application (AD32/AD36).

The later deep-detail report now reviewed in B211 explicitly qualifies several entries: Path gained a readable client follow-up, Vagrus gained cadence/market consumers, and Immortality Idle/Groundhog Life/prestige-community gained newer bounded evidence. Keep their residual catalogue, native/server and dynamic questions separately; do not continue quoting the old page-only/activities-unread state as a current universal absence. Conversely, a later preservation snapshot does not make every body semantically read. This review did not open those original corpora.

The one-realm/prestige sentence describes retired direction; apply current PROJECT scope. Dated .NET/ILSpy/Ghidra presence and StateFlags are not current installation authority or evidence of an executable consumer. Use the current registry and exact payload only when such work is selected, preserving entitlement versus installation versus readable data versus semantic/runtime evidence. No account ownership, present manifest scan, acquisition queue replacement or research launch was performed.
